items.kill: Permanent left pipeline + center stage + right dashboard + bottom console on every job
items.reason: It prevents any view from having a clear primary task.

items.kill: Cyber-terminal styling as the default product identity
items.reason: Tiny mono labels, uppercase scaffolding, grids, amber stripes, and chrome add density without meaning.

items.kill: Readiness and blocker truth repeated as scores, badges, cards, pipeline rows, overlays, and logs
items.reason: One selected cause and its repair path must replace narration by repetition.

items.kill: Nested bordered cards and pill mosaics as hierarchy
items.reason: Use spatial grouping, typography, dividers, and contextual disclosure.

items.kill: Keeping the scene visible when it is unrelated wallpaper, or covering it with a next-action card
items.reason: The scene must either be the active artifact or yield space to the selected work object.

items.kill: Replacing the cockpit with faux brutalism, glossy game-HUD chrome, glass cards, or ornamental 3D
items.reason: A new trend is not a new product hierarchy.

items.kill: Decorative metrics, fake previews, or claimed success detached from runtime evidence
items.reason: Every readiness and export claim must link to exact evidence.
